d: Masked ICE agents arrest a father and his adult daughter on a crowded jet bridge at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport, triggering outrage after footage shows the chaotic confrontation and desperate screams. Ricardo Larrondo Mendoza and Sofia Hernandez Mejia were boarding an Alaska Airlines flight to California for a family baptism when they were detained. ICE says the father overstayed his visa and alleges his daughter assaulted an officer with hot coffee. Their lawyer disputes the account, saying both have pending asylum claims and no criminal records. Washington Governor Bob Ferguson…
